name: DeepSeek-TNG-R1T2-Chimera
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528 (config.json max_position_embeddings 163840). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528: 61 full GQA layers (kv heads 128, head_dim 56) and 0 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-27. A merge of deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-0528, not a new base model: same config.json, same 684.49 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence mit, repo created 2025-07-02. Caveat: a merge (AoE) of R1, R1T, V3-0324 and R1-0528, so the base column R1 is one of its own parents. Some rows are not the authors' own runs: Aider Polyglot is sourced from the Aider discord at t=0.75, EQ-Bench from the public leaderboard, Vectara from its leaderboard. It loses AIME-25 to R1-0528 (70.0 vs 87.5) and trails R1-0528 on GPQA, so it is a cheaper R1 replacement, not the frontier. Card's pitch is intelligence-per-token, which we do not record as a benchmark.
